brief:
Israeli occupation forces have converted a residential house in Al-Jaroushiya village, located north of Tulkarem in the occupied West Bank, into a military barracks, Shehab Wire reported. The move marks another instance of Israeli forces repurposing Palestinian civilian structures for military operations in the territory.

The conversion adds to a documented pattern of Israeli military appropriation of Palestinian homes and property during occupation operations. Such takeovers have displaced families and disrupted communities across the West Bank. The specific timing of when Israeli forces seized and converted the Al-Jaroushiya residence remained unclear from initial reports.
